title: What causes you to switch to a different ai 3d generation platform?
author: BoxComprehensive1049
selftext: what makes you stay on a platform or switch to a different ai platform? is it the pricing? the quality of output? any other delays?

comments.author: StrongLegStrongMan
comments.body:
You need to learn how to use blender. Its super easy and fun. I use Blender MCP plus Astra. [https://x.com/Jonatha20313374](https://x.com/Jonatha20313374)

Ask GPT to make art and then tell it to make more art of the same theme. You can then name the art as a skill and reuse the skill whenever you want. I have been using a skill for the past month and today I updated it and made 5 variations of it.

replies.author: Verdux_Xudrev
replies.body: I want to know more as I've been trying to learn Blender just as a skill for me, but I just don't have the energy or know what I want to make that's easy. What helps you?

replies.author: StrongLegStrongMan
replies.body:
First of all do you have MCP working?

Second, if you do, you just start! I'll help. Make me concept art of a house. If you like it, say make it in blender, if you don't say make an alternative. 

It doesn't take long, then you can say, rate the roof using criteria that you can explain to me. Rate it from 0.0 to 10.0. You will then get a bunch of data back, if you are lazy say, "improve the lowest point." If you aren't lazy you can read through it all and steer edits. 

It doesn't take long before you have something you like. I just updated my twitter with an animation of the monkey I made. The prompt was make the monkey run with a slider of top speed at 55km/hour.

The biggest hurdle for blender and everything else is Sloth. It's the year of Sloth and not believing in yourself. When you overcome sloth and just type something stupid to everyone but you, you will get good results. AI is a wonder because no one is there to judge you anymore. Yesterday the world laughed when you tried to do something with no research ever performed on the topic, today the AI says, "Let's do it!!!!" 

I am working on many many things and the only thing in the way is my self and the old voices saying my research is dumb. AI never tells me that, instead I am advancing. I do math and games. My math research is great with no critics. The AI just straight up says, it works or doesn't.

replies.author: Haunting-Frosting417
replies.body:
For these assets, if I have only paid Gemini and Claude, can I still prompt assets?

replies.author: StrongLegStrongMan
replies.body:
When working with Codex you can create art using the built in image-gen skill. If you like the style that is being provided then you can ask GPT to make it into a skill. I have art skills like Cartoon Style 1 and Cartoon Style 2.

Then when working you can say, make me a house in Cartoon Style 1 ready for blender. It will produce a picture that you can play with in blender using MCP. 

You have to feed the AI multiple images and have it produce image back to you. Give it a house and a tree and a rock and a man. Say make me a sheep in this style. If you like it, say, "Make this a skill called Art Style 1. That way I can make anything in this style."
